newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF to hold briefing on Hanwa Bank objection.
newsitem.headline: MOF to hold briefing on Hanwa Bank objection.

text.p: Japan's Finance Ministry said it would hold a news briefing at 4.15 p.m. (0715 GMT) on Monday about an objection filed last month by Hanwa Bank Ltd to the ministry's liquidation scheme for the failed bank.
The ministry said in November it had suspended operations at the second-tier regional bank, except for deposit withdrawals, as Hanwa was unable to recover bad loans.
Hanwa Bank sources have said there are unresolved issues regarding guarantees of job security for the bank's 850 employees.
Japanese media have reported that the ministry is likely to reject Hanwa's objection.
